task.title: Search or filter the alerts list
task.shortdesc: Table Alert details displayed on Alerts page

row.entry: The search box that allows you to search for specific alerts. It is located on the top right of the Alerts page. To search for an alert from the list, type in any keyword related to the alert including the motor name, component name process / plant name, status, description, action, or month / year. placeholder Figure 74 Search box on Alerts page

The name of the motor. To filter or customize the alerts list based on the motor name, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more motor names from the drop-down list. placeholder Figure 75 Motor filter on Alerts page

The name of the motor component / fault. To filter or customize the alerts list based on the motor component, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more components from the drop-down list. placeholder Figure 76 Component filter on Alerts page

The plant and process name associated with the motor. To filter or customize the alerts list based on their corresponding plant and process, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more combinations of plant and process name. placeholder Figure 77 Plant and process filter on Alerts page

The current health status of the motor. To filter or customize the alerts list based on the health status, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more health statuses from the drop-down list. placeholder Figure 78 Status filter on Alerts page
The description of the alert. For example, if a motor’s status is Alarm, this field describes the exact fault detected with the motor or the component.
The suggested course of action to be taken to fix a fault.
The date and time when the alarm was first raised. To sort the alerts list based on the initial alarm date, click the placeholder arrow to sort the list.
The date and time when the motor was recovered or repaired. To sort the alerts list based on the recovered / repaired date, click the placeholder arrow to sort the list.
